mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point rise in unemployment rate over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness that triggers corporate revenue revisions downward, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of interaction periods, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 108.0 signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate capital expenditure and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of INDPRO < 108.0 periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales over the past month indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of RSAFS rising periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that prompts monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth and rising unemployment signal labor market contraction that reduces household income and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of interaction periods, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1200.0 indicate housing market recovery that boosts related sectors and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of HOUST > 1200.0 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
